name: Cell Gatekeeper
description: Use the visible membrane controls to establish concentration gradients. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-created tabs and their visible controls are allowed.
natural_language: Gate the membrane. Place the required selective leak, watch a passive crossing, and eject it. Then place and fuel the sodium and potassium ATP pumps until both concentration pairs enter their target bands. Keep every bar inside its target band for 6 transport ticks, then lock. Use only screenshots and visible task controls in this webpage; do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload/navigation, extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: Original self-contained membrane editor inspired by the surveyed PhET Membrane Transport controls. No PhET code, artwork, or runtime assets are copied.
metadata.notes: Baseline is Difficulty 3 / Full interaction. The live world shows moving particles, selective transporter crossings, ATP consumption, and target bands. Profiles remain provisional until human and computer-use-agent calibration.
